imageAlt: Superworms - live food for lizards, bearded dragons and leopard geckos

description.html: Superworms are a soft, nutritious feeder insect used as an excellent complement to dubia roaches in a lizard's diet. Their soft shell makes them easy to digest, and the extra variety helps achieve a better nutritional balance when they are combined with other insects. They are suitable for bearded dragons, leopard geckos, chameleons and other insect eaters.

description.text: Sizes and which animals they suit

description.html: They are available in three sizes - small for babies, medium for juveniles and large for adult lizards. Size rule: the insect must not be wider than the space between the animal's eyes. Dust live food with calcium before feeding, and occasionally with a multivitamin, for healthy bones and proper development.
